messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — PROD api-gateway: sudden spike in 5xx (502/504) from edge -> upstream. region=us-west-2, rate ~8.6% over 3m, paging @maya @chris @lina. playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/gw-502-playbook>

maya: ack — i'm oncall. moving to #incident-war-room and grabbing metrics.

chris: seeing a lot of 502s from the edge layer returning `no healthy upstream` and some 504 from the router -> backend timeouts. netstat on router-0 shows MANY TIME_WAIT and connection queues hitting accept backlog.

lina: can we confirm any recent deploys to router or upstream in the last 10m? also, what's the customer impact?

deploy-bot: recent rollout: `api-router:v2.14` finished 6m ago (canary->prod). rollout_id=rl-20260315-3321. rollback snippet:```bash
redwood deploy rollback rl-20260315-3321 --service api-router --region us-west-2
```

maya: initial customer impact: ~7% of requests experienced 5xx in last 5m, error budget burn alarm fired. CS notified.

chris: hypothesis: new router build opened more upstream connections and hit connection table exhaustion on backend LB -> upstream RSTs. seeing `connection reset by peer` in router logs. attaching tail:```
[router-0] 2026-03-15T21:18:43Z ERROR upstream connection reset id=0x7f2a
[router-1] 2026-03-15T21:18:44Z WARN  accept backlog full
```

lina: mitigations to try now (short list):
- throttle ingress at edge for x-rw-api key heavy clients (temp rate limit)
- shift 10% traffic to stable router pool (pre-v2.14)
- increase backend connection pool sizes on router hosts
- rollback if traffic shift doesn't help in 5m

maya: doing traffic shift 10% -> stable now. command:```bash
redwood routing set-split --service api-gateway --region us-west-2 --weights v2.14=90,v2.13=10 --reason "502 surge mitigation"
```

maya: executed — responses: `ok` from control plane. watching.

ops-sre: bumped router conn_pool from 500 -> 1200 on all hosts in us-west-2 (quick restart applied via ssm). monitoring tcp metrics.

chris: immediate effect: 5xx dropped from 8.6% -> 2.9% within 90s. latency p95 still elevated at ~820ms. seeing fewer RSTs but some backend timeouts remain.

customer-success: CS update: we pushed an advisory to affected customers and opened priority tickets for any paying customers with >10% request failures. sending templated message now. estimated impacted customers: ~12 orgs with degraded experiences.

maya: progress note — we'll hold the 10% fallback for 15m and keep conn_pool increases. if errors <1% for 10m we will gradually shift back. if not, prepare rollback of rl-20260315-3321.

alex: logging note — increase retention of request traces for this timeframe and pin a golden request set for evals. also flagging for postmortem.

incident-bot: status update: severity downgraded from P0 -> P1 (reduction in impact). links: metrics <https://redwood.internal/metrics/gateway?from=3141592600&to=3141593200>, logs <https://logs.redwood.internal/gateway/3141592653>.

maya: typing... will post final update after 15m check. :thumbsup:
